description: Compared 4 research team configurations (varying agent count and subagents) researching the same topics: system inefficiencies and archive team tools

notable_unique_findings: Stress-test phantom entries in cross-references.json (INEFF-004, INEFF-005)
Sources index completely empty despite using 5 APIs
Benchmark schema has unused aspirational fields
HTTP request boilerplate duplicated 15+ times across codebase (INEFF-002)
dedup_utils not used by iterative method despite being available (INEFF-009)
IDF computed from only 2 documents makes TF-IDF meaningless (INEFF-005)
Cross-reference corroboration inflation via loose keyword matching (INEFF-006)
All activity on single date undermines temporal tracking (INEFF-019)
Quality score formula favors quantity over quality (INEFF-016)
Query variant generation is naive with nonsensical reorders (INEFF-009)
Hardcoded 'machine learning' bias in arXiv fallback (INEFF-010)
No unit tests for any data gathering method (INEFF-021)

consensus_findings: DuckDuckGoParser class duplicated across 4 files (all 4 configs)
Silent error handling / bare except clauses (all 4 configs)
arXiv uses HTTP not HTTPS (3 of 4 configs)
Inconsistent team ID formats (3 of 4 configs)

analysis.reasoning: Best efficiency ratio: 19 findings in 48s (fastest completion). Found unique algorithmic bugs (IDF computation, URL normalization order) that other configs missed. The 3-agent structure provided enough specialization without the coordination overhead of 4 agents.
analysis.diminishing_returns: Config 4 found 25 issues but took 102s — only 6 more findings than Config 3 at 2x the duration. Many of Config 4's additional findings were lower severity.
analysis.solo_surprise: Config 1 was surprisingly effective — 15 findings and 10 tool proposals from a single agent in 84s. It found unique stress-test artifact issues (phantom entries) that multi-agent configs missed.
analysis.recommendation: For research tasks of this scope, 3 agents with 2 subagents each provides the best quality-to-cost ratio. Solo agents are viable for smaller scope. 4+ agents show diminishing returns.
